reason: The plugin integrates configured vision and text-only LLM providers by converting chat image attachments into descriptions before forwarding requests to DeepSeek.

summaries.zh: 该插件将聊天中的图片附件发送至配置的视觉模型生成描述，再交由文本模型继续处理对话。
summaries.en: This plugin sends chat image attachments to a configured vision model for description before forwarding the resulting text to a text-only model.

capabilities: Reads image attachments from chat requests
Sends image content and prompts to a configured vision model endpoint
Replaces image blocks with generated text descriptions before forwarding requests to a fallback text model
Caches image descriptions and retries selected vision endpoint failures
